adjudication.rationale: The diff adds `parseRefreshTokenResponse` which, after `safeParse`, forcibly injects `refresh_token = "refresh_token"` when missing (`packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`). In `Office365CalendarService`, the result is then merged into the existing credentials via spread: `o365AuthCredentials = { ...o365AuthCredentials, ...(tokenResponse.success && tokenResponse.data) };` (`packages/app-store/office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`). If the refresh response lacks a `refresh_token` (common for refresh flows), the injected literal will overwrite the real stored refresh token, causing permanent credential corruption/data loss. Also, `parseRefreshTokenResponse` switches to the minimal sync schema purely based on `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT`, not on `userId`; meanwhile `refreshOAuthTokens` only uses the sync endpoint when `userId` is truthy. Thus for team credentials (`userId` null) the refresh happens locally but parsing still uses the minimal schema, reaching the same injected-placeholder overwrite path.
